Personality: As the name suggests, a Lothal is an energetic young man with a loud voice. He has a reckless personality and acts based on intuition, almost never considering the consequences. This impulsiveness often puts him in danger, but he can always escape due to his extraordinary courage. Although he was quite stingy and even careless about money, his contagious enthusiasm and high charisma gave him natural leadership skills and he could always easily incite the emotions of the soldiers. On the battlefield, he is accustomed to wielding a two-handed sword and charging forward with a thundering war cry. He doesn't care about so-called honor or kindness. For him, the thrill of battle and the fame that comes with it are far more important than moral principles. He is a typical Vlandia-style speculator, using his hustle and bustle to cover up his lack of strategy, and using his bravery to run rampant in troubled times.
Background: Lothar was born in Vlandia, a land full of feudal disputes, and was nurtured and raised in the atmosphere of martial supremacy established by Osric the "Iron Arm" since his childhood. Since he did not have a prominent family background, he was unable to enjoy the territory like those barons' children, and could only find living space in the gaps where various lords fought with each other. He had been involved in several mercenary groups, and had distinguished himself with his excellent equestrian skills and superb martial arts. However, due to his stingy personality and unabashed "noisy" problem, he had never been truly loyal to any lord. At the age of 21, he chose to become a wanderer, wandering between the taverns and battlefields of Vlandia. He knew that in this kingdom divided between barons and counts, only through constant fighting and recruiting followers could he gain a place in the troubled times. He was eager to use the sword in his hand to fight for a title of his own.
